find_instructions('wifi').title: Connect to the practice campus network
steps: Check that Wi-Fi is enabled and airplane mode is off.
If connection fails, forget the saved network and try connecting again.
If the problem remains, check the service status before preparing a ticket.

find_instructions('password').title: Recover access to the practice account
steps: Open the practice sign-in screen and choose Forgot password.
Follow the recovery instructions shown by the practice application.
If recovery is unavailable, prepare a ticket describing the error.
Never include a password or recovery code in a ticket.

check_service_status('wifi', 'normal').message: The demo Wi-Fi service has no reported outage.

check_service_status('wifi', 'wifi_outag.message: The demo Wi-Fi service is unavailable across campus. The fixture gives no repair time.

check_service_status('wifi', 'status_una.message: The demo Wi-Fi status source is unavailable.

check_service_status('password', 'recove.message: The demo account-recovery service is unavailable. The fixture gives no repair time.

prepare_ticket(no steps).error: Ask the user for: steps already tried. Do not invent details.
